name: augmentedopen5e
description: An Azion Edge Functions API to augment Open5e 5th Edition SRD content with automatic LLM translations.

scripts.deploy:staging: if [ "$CI" = "true" ]; then echo 'Do not run staging on CI.' && exit 1; else AZION_ENV=staging azion ${AZION_TOKEN:+-t $AZION_TOKEN} deploy --local --config-dir azion/staging -y; fi
scripts.deploy:prod: if [ "$CI" != "true" ]; then echo 'Only run production deploy in CI.' && exit 1; else AZION_ENV=production azion ${AZION_TOKEN:+-t $AZION_TOKEN} deploy --local --config-dir azion/production -y; fi

author: Vieira
